title: Notice: 11-754 - Amendments to National Policy 43-201 MRRS for Prospectuses and Annual Information Forms, Amendments to National Policy 12-201 MRRS for Exemptive Relief Applications, Amendments to National Instrument 51-101
text:
Notices / News Releases
1.1.2 OSC Notice 11-754
OSC NOTICE 11-754
AMENDMENTS TO NATIONAL POLICY 43-201
MUTUAL RELIANCE REVIEW SYSTEM FOR
PROSPECTUSES
AND ANNUAL INFORMATION FORMS,
AMENDMENTS TO NATIONAL POLICY 12-201
MUTUAL RELIANCE REVIEW SYSTEM FOR
EXEMPTIVE RELIEF APPLICATIONS,
AMENDMENTS TO NATIONAL INSTRUMENT 51-101
STANDARDS OF DISCLOSURE FOR OIL AND GAS
ACTIVITIES,
AND MULTILATERAL INSTRUMENT 81-104
COMMODITY POOLS
The Commission is publishing in today’s Bulletin a Notice
regarding:
(cid:128) Multilateral Instrument 11-101 Principal
Regulator System, Form 11-101F1
Principal Regulator Notice Under
National Instrument 11-101, and
Companion Policy 11-101CP Principal
Regulator System;
(cid:128) Amendments to National Policy 43-201
Mutual Reliance Review System for
Prospectuses;
(cid:128) Amendments to National Policy 12-201
Mutual Reliance Review System for
Exemptive Relief Applications;
(cid:128) Amendments to National Instrument 51-
101 Standards of Disclosure For Oil and
Gas Activities; and
(cid:128) Amendments to Multilateral Instrument
81-104 Commodity Pools.
The documents are published in Chapter 5 of today’s
Bulletin.
August 26, 2005 (2005) 28 OSCB 7003
